promise: Handcrafted journeys. Beautiful stays. Stories worth travelling for.
positioning: A global travel discovery platform helping modern travellers discover exceptional destinations, stays, experiences and thoughtfully designed journeys.
customDomainNote: Set this to a bare domain (e.g. "pehchan.travel") once its DNS points at GitHub Pages. It then overrides origin/basePath and the build emits a CNAME file. Do NOT set it before DNS resolves — GitHub will start serving the custom domain and the site becomes unreachable until DNS is correct.

affiliate.disclosureShort: Some links on this page are affiliate links. If you book through them we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.
affiliate.note: No partner contracts are active yet. Every booking module below is a live, tracked slot waiting for a partner link — nothing on this site fabricates prices, availability or offers.

sampleContentNotice: Stays and experiences in this catalogue are illustrative sample listings created to demonstrate the page structure and booking flow. They are clearly labelled and will be replaced by verified, first-hand reviewed properties as partnerships are confirmed.
basePathNote: GitHub serves a user site only when the repo is named <account>.github.io. This repo is a project site, so it lives under a subpath. Ignored when customDomain is set.
